item.title: Iran-Uzbekistan trade reaches $280 million in five months
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s trade with Uzbekistan reached about $280 million in the first five months of the current Iranian year that started on March 21, with agricultural exports, technology cooperation and joint investment identified as key areas for expanding bilateral economic ties, an Iranian official has said.

item.title: In photos: National Iranian Soldier Festival held in Tehran
item.description: The National Iranian Soldier Festival, named in honor of the late Chairman of the Chief of Staff of Iran’s Armed Forces, Major General Abdolrahim Mousavi, was held on September 27, at Imam Ali Officers’ Academy. item.title: Iran: NATO chief’s remarks confirm Europe’s ‘indispensable role’ in US-Israeli war
item.description: New York, IRNA – Iran’s Ambassador and Deputy Permanent Representative to the United Nations in New York, Gholamhossein Darzi, says NATO chief’s acknowledgment that thousands of planes took off from European territory to launch attacks against Iran demonstrates “the indispensable role” Europe played in facilitating US aggression and war crimes against Iran.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86275744/Iran-NATO-chief-s-remarks-confirm-Europe-s-indispensable-role
